spot.method: pixels > 22 levels from the local median (9 px), grown 1 px, inside the box; membrane fill + the sofa's grain

vase_line.method: the strip's low frequencies brought down to the glass left of it (light excess only), texture kept

mullion_grain.method: the flat pixels of the per-row fill (local variation < 0.35 levels) given the visible mullion's grain
